Illustration: the yard of a summer cottage by a lake. On the left a girl holds the end of a long rope; she has just flicked the rope once. The other end of the rope is tied to a wooden post, from whose arm a brass bell hangs. Halfway along the taut rope there is a single hump on its way towards the post. In the background are the lake, the wooded shore, a red cottage, a sauna and birches.
Kuvitus: stadionin katsomo. Kolmessa riv: Illustration: a stadium stand. Spectators sit in three rows, and in the middle a group of spectators has stood up with their arms raised. Next to those standing, spectators are half risen or just sitting down. The spectators do not change places, but the place where they stand up travels round the stand.
Kaavakuva, ei mittakaavassa. Ylhäällä po: Schematic diagram, not to scale. At the top a transverse wave: the rope has the shape of a sine wave, and a blue arrow points to the right for the direction of travel of the wave. At three points of the rope a vertical double-headed arrow shows that the point moves up and down, that is, perpendicular to the direction of travel. At the bottom a longitudinal wave: the coils of a long coil spring are close together in places (compression) and far apart in places (rarefaction). Above one coil a horizontal double-headed arrow shows that the coil moves back and forth along the spring. A blue arrow points to the right for the direction of travel of this wave too.
Kaavakuva: narun pää alkaa heilua ylös j: Schematic diagram: the end of a rope starts to shake up and down, and the rope is drawn in four pictures one below the other at the moments a quarter of a period, a half, three quarters and a whole period. A dashed line shows how far the wave has travelled at each moment: a quarter of a wavelength, a half, three quarters and a whole wavelength. Below the lowest picture a measuring bar shows that during one period the wave has travelled one wavelength. Behind the front the rope is at rest.
Kaksi kuvaajaa samasta aallosta allekkai: Two graphs of the same wave one below the other, amplitude 4 cm. The upper one is a snapshot of the whole rope at one moment: the horizontal axis shows the position x in metres from zero to 2.5 metres and the vertical axis the displacement y in centimetres. The distance between two successive crests, 1.0 m, is marked as the wavelength lambda and the height of the crest as the amplitude A. The lower one is the displacement of one point of the rope as a function of time: the horizontal axis shows the time t in seconds from zero to 1.25 seconds. The distance between two successive peaks, 0.50 s, is marked as the period T. The graphs look the same in shape, but the quantities on their horizontal axes are different.
valokuva: koko naru yhdellä hetkellä: snapshot: the whole rope at one moment
yksi kohta: poikkeama ajan funktiona: one point: displacement as a function of time
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: narun valokuva yh: Graph to scale: a snapshot of the rope at one moment. On the horizontal axis the position x in metres from zero to four metres, grid lines every half metre and values every metre. On the vertical axis the displacement y in centimetres, grid lines every two centimetres. The rope has the shape of a sine wave, and its crests, at a height of 4 cm, are at 0.5 m, 2.0 m and 3.5 m. The wavelength is not marked.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: narun yhden kohda: Graph to scale: the displacement y of one point of the rope in centimetres as a function of time t from zero to two seconds. On the time axis grid lines every 0.2 seconds and values every 0.4 seconds. The curve is a sine wave whose peaks are at a height of 5 cm. The curve starts from zero going upwards and crosses the time axis going upwards at the moments 0, 0.4, 0.8, 1.2, 1.6 and 2.0 s.
